property_summary: For any caller and any amount, the reference C only allows sendTo to succeed when called by the recorded owner; therefore calling sendTo as the owner may succeed but calling sendTo as any non-owner MUST revert (so address(c).balance cannot be decreased by a non-owner)—the mutant removes that require and thus lets some non-owner calls succeed and reduce the contract balance.
change_summary: Changed the require to check that any caller (no restriction) can call by removing the owner equality, allowing anyone to call sendTo.
